title: GWL_FCS30D: Global 30 m Annual Wetland Maps, 2000–2022
description: Annual global wetland maps at 30 m resolution, 2000–2022, with eight wetland classes, from the Aerospace Information Research Institute, Chinese Academy of Sciences (Zhang et al. 2024, Scientific Data). A Portolan mirror of Zenodo record 10068479: 22,011 Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs, one per 5° tile per year, with STAC metadata and a GeoParquet item index. CC-BY-4.0.
